faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtext: Common questions about how Sri Venkateswara Hospital works, what's included, and how to get started. If you don't find your answer here, reach out at contact@svhospital.com and we'll get back to you quickly.

items.q: How do I book an appointment with a specialist doctor?
items.a: You can request an appointment by clicking any 'Book Appointment' button on this website and filling out the short form, or by calling our desk directly at 0891-2700000. Once submitted, our coordinator will call you to confirm your exact time slot.

items.q: What are the hospital consulting hours?
items.a: Our Outpatient Department (OPD) is open Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Emergency, trauma triaging, and inpatient critical care operations are fully active 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including Sundays and public holidays.

items.q: Does the hospital handle emergency accident cases and fracture surgeries?
items.a: Yes, we are a specialized trauma care center. We have an active trauma surgical team led by senior specialists. Our operating theaters, in-house X-ray facility, diagnostics, and sterile wards are equipped for immediate admission and fracture fixing operations 24/7.

items.q: Do you offer cashless treatments or accept health insurance?
items.a: Yes. We partner with major health insurance companies and Third-Party Administrators (TPAs) to provide cashless treatment for qualifying surgical procedures. Please visit our front office with your health card and ID for pre-authorization details.

items.q: Is there in-house physical therapy available for post-surgical recovery?
items.a: Absolutely. We have a dedicated Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation department inside the hospital. Our physical therapists design customized mobility recovery and pain-management programs specifically for patients recovering from joint replacements, fracture repairs, and ligament reconstructions.
